environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway REST API (v1) with a CloudFront distribution. The CloudFront distribution has a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) attached which corresponds to the AWS managed 'SecurityHeadersPolicy'. This policy injects a Content-Security-Policy response header with value "default-src 'none'; img-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'". The policy is applied at the CloudFront behavior level with origin request policy forwarding the original Host header. Note: the Lambda function's own response headers are merged BELOW the CloudFront response header policy (CloudFront policy takes precedence for CSP). The double-free buffer pattern in the code still exists but the XSS payload delivery via template injection is neutralized because inline scripts cannot execute in the browser context.

config.csp_header: default-src 'none'; img-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
